verdict.rationale: Base44's core product is exactly this: natural-language prompts generate a full-stack app with managed backend, database, auth, and CLI/SDK access (docs-9,11,17,24,29). Community testimonials corroborate that prompting produces genuinely functional full apps, not just prototypes (e.g., 'Base44 provided me with a fully functional app', 'two prompts and deploy'), despite some skepticism about differentiation and cost.
